topics.topic: Ownership of unknown-reference detection and whether `surface` pre-checks IDs or modules return typed not-found outcomes
questions: Must `surface` pre-check existence for every referenced id before calling a module, or may modules detect missing records and return a typed not-found outcome that `surface` maps to the single unknown-reference refusal?

Does `surface` perform all record-existence checks itself before dispatch, or do operation modules perform existence checks and return a normalized unknown-reference refusal for `surface` to pass through?

quotes:
A request naming a record
   that does not exist — a flow, a flow version, a run, a binding, any other —
   is refused as State 0's unknown reference before that record's own checks,
   never as a proof failure or a missing activation; refusal codes are State
   5's.

Any operation's own checks or records; it decides only whether a request
reaches an operation and what of the answer a caller may see.
judgement.why: The texts already set both the observable rule (unknown-reference refusal timing) and the ownership boundary (surface does not own operation-specific checks).

topics.topic: Deterministic ordering and failure precedence for `bindings.check_installed_instances`, including which start-time error types it must fail on
questions: Across multiple services/instances, what exact iteration order and failure precedence must `check_installed_instances` use, and does this start step fail only on header-name collisions or also on manifest-read/shape problems encountered while obtaining `required_headers`?

topics.topic: Deterministic rule/data ownership for choosing `instance_not_selected` vs `instance_address_missing` in pre-send failures
questions: How can `service_invoker` deterministically choose between `instance_not_selected` and `instance_address_missing` (A09/A10) if it only receives ManifestOperation instance facts that may be absent in both cases?

topics.topic: Ownership/exposure of the closed HTTP-method set (where the authoritative enumeration is defined)
questions: Where is the HTTP-method closed set actually owned and exposed, given State 1 M10 lists `http_method` as a field but does not define a model enumeration for methods while A08 rule 3 constrains valid methods?

topics.topic: Source of execution-class values used for agent masking (execution records only vs including binding-declared output classes)
questions: When masking for agents, is execution class computed only from execution records, or may binding-declared output classes be included (and if so, for execution class itself or only for `failure_detail` class per A09 rule 7)?
